# Create tasks, inspect JSON, and exercise the task lifecycle.
exec weft$exe init
stdout 'Initialized Weft board'

exec weft$exe add 'Manage product images' --state todo --json
json
stdout '"title": "Manage product images"'
stdout '"state": "todo"'
exists tasks/todo/001-manage-product-images.md

exec weft$exe add 'Document image formats' --state todo --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'

exec weft$exe list todo --json
json
stdout '"title": "Manage product images"'
stdout '"title": "Document image formats"'

exec weft$exe show 001 --json
json
stdout '"title": "Manage product images"'
stdout '"body": "# Manage product images'

exec weft$exe rename 001 'Organize product images' --json
json
stdout '"title": "Organize product images"'
exists tasks/todo/001-organize-product-images.md
! exists tasks/todo/001-manage-product-images.md

exec weft$exe move 001 doing --json
json
stdout '"state": "doing"'
exists tasks/doing/001-organize-product-images.md
! exists tasks/todo/001-organize-product-images.md

exec weft$exe start 002 --json
json
stdout '"state": "doing"'
exists tasks/doing/002-document-image-formats.md

exec weft$exe done 001 --json
json
stdout '"state": "done"'
stdout '"completed_at":'
exists tasks/done/001-organize-product-images.md

exec weft$exe recent --json
json
stdout '"number": "001"'
stdout '"completed_at":'

exec weft$exe reopen 001 --json
json
stdout '"state": "doing"'
! stdout '"completed_at":'
exists tasks/doing/001-organize-product-images.md
! exists tasks/done/001-organize-product-images.md

exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
stdout '"task_count": 2'
